description: Simulate human-like virtual mouse hover over an element (triggering mouseenter, mouseover, mousemove). Supports inline post-hover waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

selector.description: CSS selector or @ref to hover over

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after hovering

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after hovering

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after hovering

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after hovering
